capabilities: Switch between 9 dark and 7 light Doom palettes, including popout windows
Style cursors, typography, spacing, layout density and indent guides
Choose outline numbering styles for nested lists across Live Preview, Reading view and PDF export
Open resizable, sticky hover preview windows with pin and sidebar actions
Toggle settings via commands bindable to hotkeys
extras: Part of a larger DoomEsque suite (Filetypes, Inline Autocomplete, Task Docket, Whole-Tree Search, etc.). Ships an offline-audit script that fails on any network API; the README also warns to disable Obsidian's own updates, Sync and Publish for a fully offline setup. Notes an iOS limitation for decimal and statutory numbering in Reading view.
motivation: The author built the suite to guarantee zero network calls so Obsidian can be used safely in open-book law exams.
problem: Obsidian's theme controls expose only a few styling options, so the DoomEsque theme's palettes, cursors, layout and preview behaviour need a dedicated settings tab.

relations.evidence: Companion plugin for the DoomEsque theme
While it is enabled it controls the shared options, so their rows here are disabled

summary: Companion settings plugin for the DoomEsque theme that adds palettes, cursors, typography, spacing, indent guides, outline numbering and sticky hover previews.
